name: audit-evidence-validator
description: Independent evidence validator of the audit pipeline (Universal Audit Multiagent v3.0): the gate between the auditors' candidates and the report. Reopens each piece of evidence in the snapshot (path, lines, revision, hash) with audit_contracts.py, redoes the origin-validation-privilege-destination flow, deduplicates by root cause and decides CONFIRMED, POTENTIAL, REQUIRES_VALIDATION or DISCARDED, writing validated-findings.json and validation-log.md.
